title: OCO index place code M1 / M2 / M3 (Vespers)
prompt: Vespers counterpart of B1/B2/B3, same dates (16/10, 9/10, 12/5, 25/5 …), sometimes with TP / TpA. 33 index row(s). Examples: #2525 'Qui sequitur me' 12/5|V|M2TpA p215; #1600 'Hic est vere martyr... alleluia.' 12/5|V|M2TP p1062; #2695 'Sancti mei' 12/5|V|M1TpA p1027; #2884 'Stabunt iusti' 12/5|V|M1TP p1045; #1455 'Exsultavit cor... et exaltatum' 16/10|V|M2 p1146; #2064 'Mensuram bonam' 16/10|V|M1 p1159. Legend OCO pp1210-1213 does not define this code. Rows with it are held: the mapper (oco/oco_sigla.py) gives no lit_part_sources target, so identity can load but the assignment waits. Answer = what the code means and where the chant goes (service.part, epoch, option_txt). Carry-out: add the rule to oco_sigla.py, re-run oco/load_oco_lps.py, record it in oco/specs/README.md 'User rulings'.

options.label: n-th saint of the date
options.detail: M1 = Magnificat antiphon of the first saint of the date, M2 of the second …; LPS → VESPERS.antM on that saint's epoch.

options.label: alternative antiphons
options.detail: two alternatives for the same office → VESPERS.antM options 1/2.
